title: My Name Shall Not Be Found on the Register of Calamity This Day
text: Father God, your name is written in the Lamb's Book of Life. Your name is sealed in the records of heaven. Your name is inscribed by the finger of God in the registry of the righteous. And this day, this very day, before the sun sets on your life, before the clock completes another revolution, before another breath leaves your body, you are standing in agreement with the decree of the most high God that your name shall not be found on the register of calamity. Not today, not this week, not this month, not this season. Your name has been removed from every evil register, every demonic ledger, every satanic record book, every witchcraft scroll that was written against your destiny. The blood of Jesus has already erased your name from every list that hell compiled against you. Job 3:25 says, "For the thing which I greatly feared is come upon me, and that which I was afraid of is come unto me. Father God, your servant is standing here right now, refusing to be on that list, refusing to be the one that fear targets, refusing to be the subject of a calamity report. Every spirit of dread that has been circling your life, every demonic anticipation of disaster that has been assigned to follow you, every dark expectation that has been planted in your spirit through fear, through anxiety, through nightmares, through bad news, through reports of others falling, be uprooted from your life right now in the name of Jesus. You are not the next victim. You are not the next casualty. You are not the next headline of failure and collapse. Every demonic narrative that has been constructed around your downfall is dismantled right now by the fire of the Holy Ghost. Your life is not a tragedy. Your story is not a cautionary tale. Your ending is not destruction. God has written a different conclusion over your life. And no demon in hell has the authority to rewrite what God has already sealed. Psalm 91:3 says, "Surely he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler and from the noisome pestilence." The Hebrew word for snare here is PCH, meaning a trap that is laid secretly, a device that collapses suddenly, a mechanism designed to catch you offguard. Right now, every pH that has been set along your path is being exposed by the light of God. Every trap that was buried in your career path is uncovered. Every snare that was hidden in your relationships is revealed and destroyed. Every device that the enemy set along your financial road is dismantled by the fire of the Holy Ghost. You will not step into any trap that was designed for your destruction. You will not trigger any mechanism that was built for your collapse. Every pH, every hidden snare, every secret device, every camouflaged pitfall is being burned up by the fire of God right now in the name of Jesus. Your feet are being redirected. Your path is being cleared. Every ambush point along your journey today is being exposed. And every demon standing at that ambush point is being scattered by the thunder of God. The register of calamity is a real demonic document. In the spirit realm, there are scrolls, there are records, there are assignments written against the children of God. Daniel 10 12-13 shows you that demonic princes hold up answers, that there are spiritual forces operating in legal frameworks in the heavenly places. But your advocate is Jesus Christ the righteous. Your attorney in the courts of heaven is the one who has never lost a case. Your intercessor at the right hand of the father [music] is the one whose blood speaks better things than the blood of Abel. Right now in the courts of heaven, [music] every charge that was written against you in the register of calamity is being struck off the record. Every demonic filing that was submitted against your name is being overturned. Every satanic petition that requested your destruction is being denied. Every evil verdict that was pronounced over your life in dark places is being reversed by the blood of Jesus Christ. You have an advocate. You have a defender. You have a legal representative in the highest court in the universe. And your case is being won right now. Isaiah 54:17 says, "No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper, and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment thou shalt condemn. This is the heritage of the servants of the Lord, and their righteousness is of me, saith the Lord. Your heritage is protection. Your inheritance is divine immunity from the weapons of the enemy. Every weapon that was formed against your health shall not prosper. Every weapon that was aimed at your marriage shall not prosper. Every weapon that was designed to destroy your children shall not prosper. Every weapon that was built to collapse your finances shall not prosper. Every tongue that rose against you in the demonic council chambers, every voice that spoke calamity over your future, every prophetic declaration that was released against your destiny by witches and warlocks and agents of darkness, you are condemning those tongues right now. You are standing on your heritage. You are claiming your righteousness in Christ Jesus. No weapon, not one, not a single weapon formed against you shall prosper this day. Right now, the book you need to take this warfare deeper is Tearown Satanic Thrones. You can get the Kindle or paperback on Amazon or grab the ebook on the stand store. The link is in the pinned comment of this live stream and also in the video description below. Go get it right now while this fire is still burning in your spirit. Do not let this moment pass because what is happening right now in the spirit over your life requires you to go deeper. The thrones that have been erected over your destiny, the altars that have been built against your name, the satanic structures that have been constructed to hold your breakthrough hostage, those thrones are coming down. And that book will give you the warfare tools to keep them [music] down permanently. Proverbs 26:2 says, "As the bird by wandering, as the swallow by flying, so the curse causeless shall not come." The Hebrew root here reveals that a curse without legal ground cannot land. It cannot attach. It cannot take effect. It wanders. It flies away like a bird with no place to perch. Right now, every curse that was spoken over your name is losing its legal ground. Every generational curse that was transmitted through your bloodline is being cut off at the root. Every curse that was spoken by a witch, by an enemy, by someone who hated your progress, by someone who was jealous of your anointing, by someone who sat at a demonic altar and called your name in darkness. Every single one of those curses is losing its perch right now. [music] There is no legal ground for any curse to land on your life because you are covered by the blood of Jesus Christ. You are washed. You are cleansed. You are justified. You are sanctified. Every curse is flying away from you right now like a bird that cannot find a branch. It shall not come. It shall not land. It shall not attach. It shall not affect you. Every register of calamity has a specific demonic scribe. There is a spirit assigned to write your name on lists of disaster, lists of untimely death, lists of financial ruin, lists of marital collapse, lists of generational failure. That scribe is being confronted right now by the angel of the Lord. Every pen that was used to write your name on a list of destruction is being broken. Every ink that was used to record your name in a demonic ledger is being dried up by the fire of God. Every scroll that contained your name in a registry of suffering is being consumed by the flame of the Holy Ghost. Your name is being removed. Your name is being erased. Your name is being struck off every list that hell compiled. And in its place your name is being written aresh in the record of divine favor in the ledger of supernatural breakthrough in the registry of those who shall see the goodness of the Lord in the land of the living. Psalm 34:1 19 says, "Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but the Lord deliverth him out of them all. Not some, not most, not the majority. Out of them all, every affliction that has been lined up against your life is being dismantled. Every affliction that was scheduled for this season, every calamity that was placed on the calendar of darkness against your name, every disaster that was planned and prepared and positioned to hit your life, the Lord is delivering you out of all of them. You are coming out. You are breaking through. You are not staying in the place of affliction. The Lord who delivered you before is delivering you again. The God who brought you out of the last crisis is bringing you out of this one. The deliverer who saved you from the last disaster is saving you from every disaster that was written in the register of calamity against your name today. Deuteronomy 28:7 says, "The Lord shall cause thine enemies to be smitten before thy face. They shall come out against thee one way and flee before thee seven ways. Every demonic enemy that was organized against your life, every spiritual enemy that was assigned to bring calamity upon you, every dark force that was mobilized to execute the evil plan written in the register against your name. They are being smitten before your face right now. They came out against you one way, but they are fleeing seven ways. They are scattered. They are confused. They are disorganized. Every coordinated demonic attack against your life is being disrupted right now by the power of the Holy Ghost. Every strategic plan that the enemy spent time organizing against your breakthrough is being dismantled. Every formation that was assembled in the spirit realm against your name is being broken up by the fire of God. You are not the one retreating today. Your enemies are the ones fleeing. You are the one advancing. You are the one gaining ground. You are the one taking territory. Every demon that was positioned to block your progress is fleeing before you seven ways in the name of Jesus. Lamentations 3:37 says, "Who is he that saith, and it cometh to pass when the Lord commandeth it not?" Nothing happens in your life without the permission of God. [snorts] No calamity can touch you without first passing through the throne room of the most high. And the God who sits on that throne has already declared that your name shall not be found on the register of calamity this day. Every evil pronouncement that was made against you is not authorized by heaven. Every declaration of disaster spoken over your future is not commanded by God. Therefore, it cannot come to pass. Therefore, it must fall to the ground empty. Therefore, it must return void to the one who sent it. The enemy has no authorization to bring calamity upon your life today. He has no permission from the throne of God. He has no legal ground in the courts of heaven. And because he has no authority, because he has no permission, because he has no legal ground, every plan he had for your destruction is cancelled in the name of Jesus. The blood of Jesus is speaking over your life right now. Hebrews 12:4 says, "The blood of Jesus speaks [music] better things than the blood of Abel." The blood of Abel cried for vengeance, but the blood of Jesus speaks redemption. The blood of Abel cried from the ground, but the blood of Jesus speaks from the throne. Right now, the blood of Jesus is speaking over every area of your life that was targeted for calamity. The blood is speaking over your health. The blood is speaking over your marriage. The blood [music] is speaking over your finances. The blood is speaking over your finances. The blood is speaking over your ministry. The blood is speaking over your future. Every area where the register of calamity had your name written, the blood of Jesus is speaking a better word. The blood is declaring your deliverance. The blood is declaring your protection. The blood is declaring your exemption from every disaster that was planned for your life. You are under the blood. You are covered by the blood. You [music] are protected by the blood. No calamity can cross the bloodline that Jesus drew around your life. Exodus 12:13 says, "And the blood shall be to you for a token upon the houses where ye are. And when I see the blood, I will pass over you, and the plague shall not be upon you to destroy you when I smite the land of Egypt." When God saw the blood, the plague passed over. When the destroyer went through Egypt that night, the blood on the doorpost was the signal, the legal token, the divine marker that said, "This household is exempt." Your household is marked with the blood of Jesus right now. Every plague that is moving through this season, every wave of calamity that is sweeping through this generation, every destroyer that was sent to execute the evil written in the register of calamity when it sees the blood of Jesus on your doorpost, it must skip your house. It must bypass your life. It cannot enter where the blood has been applied. Your health is under the blood. Your marriage is under the blood. Your children are under the blood. Your finances are under the blood. Every member of your household is under the blood of Jesus. And [music] the destroyer cannot cross that bloodline. Psalm 91:10 says, "There shall no evil befall thee, neither shall any plague come nigh thy dwelling." This is not a suggestion. This is a covenant promise. This is a divine guarantee. No evil shall befall you. No plague shall come near your dwelling right now. Every evil that was dispatched to befall you is being turned back by the covenant of God. Every plague that was aimed at your dwelling is being repelled by the promise of the most high. Every calamity that was scheduled to arrive at your address is being rerouted by the angel of the Lord. Your home is a no calamity zone. Your life is a no disaster territory. Your future is a no evil area. God has declared it. God has sworn it. God has backed it with his covenant. And what God has declared, no demon in hell can reverse. No witch can undo it. No warlock can cancel it. No satanic register can override it. No evil record can supersede the promise of God. There shall no evil befall you. That is the word of the Lord over your life today. Every morning star prayer, every midnight witchcraft ritual, every dawn sacrifice that was offered with your name attached, every demonic prayer that was prayed at crossroads with your photograph. Every incantation that was spoken over your name in darkness, every ritual that was performed to write your name into the register of calamity, every single one of those operations is being nullified right now by the fire of the Holy Ghost. The fire of God is consuming every [music] dark prayer that was prayed against you. The fire of God is burning up every evil sacrifice that was offered against your destiny. The fire of God is destroying every ritual that was performed to seal your name in the ledger of disaster. You are free. You are loosed. You are delivered from every satanic prayer that was sent against your life. Every arrow that was shot at you in the midnight hour is falling harmlessly to the ground. Every dart that was released against you in the third watch of the night is returning to sender. You are free in the name of Jesus. Numbers 23:23 says, "Surely there is no enchantment against Jacob, neither is there any divination against Israel. [music] According to this time it shall be said of Jacob and of Israel, what hath God wrought. You are the Israel of God. You are the Jacob of this generation. There is no enchantment that can work against you. There is no divination that can succeed against you. Every enchantment that was performed against your destiny is broken. Every divination that was released over your name is cancelled. Every occultic operation that was mobilized against your future is nullified. Every dark word that was spoken over your life through the spirit of divination is rendered powerless by the blood of Jesus. What shall be said of your life in this season is not what the enemy wrote in the register of calamity. What shall be said of your life is what hath God wrought. What God has done in your life shall be the testimony. What God has built in your life shall be the evidence. What God has decreed over your life shall be the final word. Every demonic imagination that was constructed against you is being made an utter end by the Lord himself. [snorts] Every satanic plan that was imagined in the darkest chambers of hell against your life, the Lord is making an utter end of it. That sickness that keeps coming back, the Lord is making an utter end of it. That financial crisis that keeps returning, the Lord is making an utter end of it. The Hebrew word for peace here is shalom. Shalom means completeness, wholeness, nothing missing, nothing broken, soundness in every dimension. The thoughts God thinks toward you are shalom thoughts. The plans God has for your life are shalom plans. The future God has prepared for your expected end is a shalom future. Every plan that contradicts shalom, every assignment that opposes shalom, every demonic register that listed you for calamity instead of shalom is being overturned by the original intention of God for your life. God knew you before you were formed in the womb. God established your destiny before the foundation of the world. God wrote your expected end in the book of heaven before any demon could write your name in the register of calamity. And the original manuscript of God for your life is the one that stands. Every spirit of untimely death, every assignment of early grave, every demonic plan for your premature ending be destroyed in the name of Jesus. You shall live and not die. You shall declare the works of the Lord. The angel of the Lord is encamping around your life right now. Psalm 34:7 says, "The angel of the Lord encampeth round about them that fear him and deliverth them." The angel of the Lord has not just passed by your life. The angel of the Lord has pitched a tent around you. The angel of the Lord has set up a permanent military encampment around your life. Every demon that tries to approach your life must first face that angelic garrison. Every calamity that tries to reach you must first get past the camp of the Lord. Every disaster that was dispatched against you must contend with the hosts of heaven that are surrounding you right now. You are not unprotected. You are not exposed. You are not vulnerable. Hell wrote your name on that list without factoring in the divine protection that covers you. And because of that divine covering, every plan written against you in that register is already defeated. The sword of the spirit has cut you loose. [music] Jesus took it. Jesus bore it. Jesus canled it on the cross. Every ordinance that the register of calamity was built upon has already been blotted out by the blood of Jesus.
